title: Steps to perform antiSMASH analysis for bacteria
author: Rekadwad, Bhagwan
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0
materials: taking part in various cellular processes.

steps.title: Open antiSMASH web interface
steps.instruction: Navigate to https://antismash.secondarymetabolites.org/ (accessed on Feb 7 2023 at 16:44:21) and open the bacterial antiSMASH data input window.

steps.title: Upload or retrieve genome sequence
steps.instruction: Either upload the bacterial genome sequence in FASTA format or retrieve it directly from NCBI if it has already been deposited.

steps.title: Set notification and job link options
steps.instruction: Choose to receive an email notification for the analyzed genome, or alternatively bookmark the job link or copy and save it; the results will remain accessible for one month.

steps.title: View region colour coding
steps.instruction: In the output, observe that the genome of Actinopolyspora mortivallis DSM 44261 (accession NZ_KB913024.1) displays colour‑coded secondary‑metabolite regions numbered 1–25.

steps.title: Inspect ectoine gene clusters
steps.instruction: Examine the graphical representation of the ectoine gene clusters located in region 1 and region 15, which participate in various cellular processes.
